1.consolidated_definition: Emparedado constituido por tres rebanadas de pan, generalmente tostadas y entre las cuales se coloca pollo o jamón, queso, lechuga y tomate y que se sirve cortado en cuatro partes triangulares.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Triangular sandwich consisting of three slices of bread, typically toasted, with chicken or ham, cheese, lettuce, and tomato placed between them, served cut into four triangular portions.
